verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's docs describe a ninth-gen NVENC hardware encoder that speeds up video exports and AI effects in DaVinci Resolve and Adobe Premiere. They also say NVIDIA Studio and RTX 50 Series accelerate video editing, 3D rendering and graphic design, so the media engine and creator-app acceleration are documented. However, the evidence never names AV1 or HEVC encode support, and it never mentions Studio Drivers or ISV certification. Missing for 10: explicit AV1/HEVC encoder documentation, Studio/ISV-certified driver claims, independent or hands-on corroboration of encoder or creator-app performance.
